page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs, which correspond to 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, and 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression is in the bottom 10%. However, the instance leverages its 32 vCPUs to deliver average multi-core performance in stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for large blocks remains average, though the Passmark memory score is weak.

Given the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average multi-core processing capabilities, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads that benefit from parallelization rather than raw single-thread speed. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, multi-threaded decompression, Redis database operations, and medium-sized LLM inference tasks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density provide a stable environment for enterprise applications without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware.
